What is LisBon Flow Infrastructure (LFI)?

LFI coordinates route-based work across operators, jobs, assets, locations, execution states and completion records. It gives transport, logistics, delivery and field-service organisations one authoritative view of what should move and what actually happened.

Who is LisBon Flow Infrastructure (LFI) for?

Transport, logistics and delivery businesses that want connected operations under their own brand.

What problem does LisBon Flow Infrastructure (LFI) solve?

Routes, jobs and field work are split across calls, messages, paper, spreadsheets and disconnected systems.

How does LisBon Flow Infrastructure (LFI) work?

LFI maintains the operating state behind scheduled work, assignments, execution, completion, exceptions and history.

What changes once LisBon Flow Infrastructure (LFI) is running?

Managers and field teams see the same operation from the view appropriate to their role.

How is success measured?

Assignment clarity; execution visibility; completion evidence; exception time; reconciliation effort.

Can LisBon Flow Infrastructure (LFI) be deployed for a single organisation?

Yes. AlphaIT licenses, deploys, configures and integrates the system for each organisation, and engineers the missing connection or capability where the ready system does not fully fit. Scope, integrations, data permissions, acceptance checks, support and commercial terms are agreed per deployment.

Which countries can LisBon Flow Infrastructure (LFI) be deployed in?

AlphaIT Engineering works with organisations in Kenya, Nigeria, the United Arab Emirates and the wider Middle East. Deployment is subject to applicable law, the data permissions available and the authority of each participating organisation.
